final_message:
I implemented `flag_transcripts` in `labkit/safety/monitor.py`, but I haven't run the tests, so I can't say whether they pass.

My first Bash call, which wrote the change and ran `python3 -m unittest tests.test_s5_monitor`, was denied. The session has no way to approve permission prompts, so I didn't retry it or try another way to run the tests. I made the change with the Edit tool instead, and that succeeded.

The function compiles each pattern once with `re.IGNORECASE`. It then returns `(transcript_index, pattern)` for every transcript where `re.search` finds a match. Results are ordered by transcript index, then by pattern order. I checked it by reading it against the two tests, `test_flags` and `test_regex`. I expect both to pass.

To confirm, run `python3 -m unittest tests.test_s5_monitor` yourself.
